definitions.gloss: neat; tidy; trim (of a person's appearance or a place)
definitions.explanation: Clean and pleasantly neat without being grand or showy: a modest room kept in good order, a person dressed neatly. Mild praise; the {小|こ} softens きれい to "nice and neat".

examples.japanese: {小綺麗|こぎれい}な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{小綺麗|こぎれい}な⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小綺麗|こぎれい}な⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{帰|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧みた。
examples.english: A neat little café opened by the station, so I stopped in on my way home from work.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小綺麗|こぎれい}な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧/⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a neat little room / shop
- {小綺麗|こぎれい}な⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧: a neat, tidy outfit
- {小綺麗|こぎれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tidy up; to smarten oneself up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧: beautiful; clean — the plain word, stronger praise
- ⟦こざっぱり→こざっぱり：33023_kozappari⟧: neat and clean, fresh (of clothes or a person)
- ⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧: clean, hygienic — about hygiene, not looks

WRITING: also written こぎれい or {小奇麗|こぎれい}.
